summary: This project has two main components: a storytelling flipbook and an interactive timeline highlighting important space missions and events. Together, these components will explain the story of the equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space, explaining its purpose, discoveries and impact on space exploration. This project will also talk about how this equipment affects the space environment and explain ways to reduce waste and encourage a cleaner future in space. This is important to learn because the moon and mars might be our homes in the future and it is important to keep it clean.
details:
The first component of our project is a flip book that has several pages talking about the discarded equipment on the moon, mars and in deep space from their own perspectives. The reader flips through the pages to learn about the discarded equipment left behind in space. The introduction and conclusion are from earth’s perspective and are a reflection of all the resources that are being used on earth. Claude was used to convert the illustrated book to a flip book.  

The next component is an interactive timeline that takes you through history to teach you about the different equipment used to travel to space with or without humans. Viewers will be able to click on the different tabs to view the timeline and answer questions about the reading at the bottom. Claude was used to create a timeline using the text from the illustrated book. 

GitHub was used to create a website for the flip book and interactive timeline.

The main factor our team considered while creating this project was time. A lot of time was spent for after-school collaboration to complete this project. Developing the flipbook and interactive timeline required a lot of time, research and planning but it was a rewarding process and a very good learning experience for all of us.
